items.title: Mubit + Neon AI Gateway: an agent that cuts its own frontier-model tokens by 73%
items.summary: Mubit is middleware for AI agents. It sits between your agent and the model with a one-line endpoint change, learns from every call, and moves recurring steps to small models tuned on your own traffic, while the frontier model keeps the hard ones. There's nothing extra to host...
items.creator: Carlota Soto
